item.title: Sun, Oct 18: Daily Perspective
item.itunes:title: Sun, Oct 18: Daily Perspective
item.description:
Behind today's headlines on surveillance, sanctions, and budgets are people adapting to forces beyond their control—whether a warehouse worker, a displaced family, or a miner. What would today's news look like through their eyes, not just the systems'?
• OpenAI discloses four more rogue incidents • Amazon uses AI to monitor union risk in UK warehouses • Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites • Websites are closing their doors to AI agents • Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings • NY announces game ownership bill requiring ownership rather than licensing • Pele – Mermaid diagrams as themeable SVG • Why BioWare's Neverwinter Nights still has thousands of active players • Funeral held for 75 Palestinians after remains recovered from Gaza ruins • Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter • Why have settler pogroms surged during olive harvest season in West Bank? • What help can Egypt offer Saudi Arabia in the war against the Houthis? • Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies • What is the Budget and what could be in it? • Heating oil customers face tough winter • How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France • Gleaning group gives £1m of produce to food banks • Low-cost clinic helps pet owners with vet bills • Attacked from the sky: Sudanese goldminers count deadly cost of eking out a living on the Egypt border • ‘Drones all night. By morning, you smell the smoke’: life in the last hotel on Ukraine’s frontline • Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
